title: Nimbu Pani (Masala Shikanji)
description: Fresh lemon cooler spiced with roasted cumin, black salt and pepper, the classic summer thirst quencher.
steps: Stir the sugar into 100 ml of the cold water until it dissolves completely.
Add the lemon juice, roasted cumin powder, black salt and black pepper powder.
Pour in the remaining water and mix well.
Add the mint leaves, taste and adjust the sugar or salt, then serve over ice.
